v.t: Glory to Him who journeyed His servant by night, from the Sacred Mosque, to the Farthest Mosque, whose precincts We have blessed, in order to show him of Our wonders. He is the Listener, the Beholder
v.l: Subhana Al-Ladhi 'Asra Bi`abdihi Laylaan Mina Al-Masjidi Al-Harami 'Ila Al-Masjidi Al-'Aqsa Al-Ladhi Barakna Hawlahu Linuriyahu Min 'Ayatina 'Innahu Huwa As-Sami`u Al-Basiru

v.t: And We gave Moses the Scripture, and made it a guide for the Children of Israel: Take none for protector other than Me
v.l: Wa 'Atayna Musa Al-Kitaba Wa Ja`alnahu Hudaan Libani 'Isra'ila 'Alla Tattakhidhu Min Duni Wa Kilaan

v.t: The descendants of those We carried with Noah. He was an appreciative servant
v.l: Dhurriyata Man Hamalna Ma`a Nuhin 'Innahu Kana `Abdaan Shakuraan

v.t: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Scripture: You will commit evil on earth twice, and you will rise to a great height
v.l: Wa Qađayna 'Ila Bani 'Isra'ila Fi Al-Kitabi Latufsidunna Fi Al-'Arđi Marratayni Wa Lata`lunna `Uluwaan Kabiraan

v.t: When the first of the two promises came true, We sent against you servants of Ours, possessing great might, and they ransacked your homes. It was a promise fulfilled
v.l: Fa'idha Ja'a Wa`du 'Ulahuma Ba`athna `Alaykum `Ibadaan Lana 'Uli Ba'sin Shadidin Fajasu Khilala Ad-Diyari Wa Kana Wa`daan Maf`ulaan

v.t: Then We gave you back your turn against them, and supplied you with wealth and children, and made you more numerous
v.l: Thumma Radadna Lakumu Al-Karrata `Alayhim Wa 'Amdadnakum Bi'amwalin Wa Banina Wa Ja`alnakum 'Akthara Nafiraan

v.t: If you work righteousness, you work righteousness for yourselves; and if you commit evil, you do so against yourselves. Then, when the second promise comes true, they will make your faces filled with sorrow, and enter the Temple as they entered it the first time, and utterly destroy all that falls into their power
v.l: In 'Ahsantum 'Ahsantum Li'nfusikum Wa 'In 'Asa'tum Falaha Fa'idha Ja'a Wa`du Al-'Akhirati Liyasu'u Wujuhakum Wa Liyadkhulu Al-Masjida Kama Dakhaluhu 'Awwala Marratin Wa Liyutabbiru Ma `Alaw Tatbiraan

v.t: Perhaps your Lord will have mercy on you. But if you revert, We will revert. We have made Hell a prison for the disbelievers
v.l: Asa Rabbukum 'An Yarhamakum Wa 'In `Udtum `Udna Wa Ja`alna Jahannama Lilkafirina Hasiraan

v.t: This Quran guides to what is most upright; and it gives good news to the believers who do good deeds, that they will have a great reward
v.l: Inna Hadha Al-Qur'ana Yahdi Lillati Hiya 'Aqwamu Wa Yubashiru Al-Mu'uminina Al-Ladhina Ya`maluna As-Salihati 'Anna Lahum 'Ajraan Kabiraan

v.t: And those who do not believe in the Hereafter—We have prepared for them a painful punishment
v.l: Wa 'Anna Al-Ladhina La Yu'uminuna Bil-'Akhirati 'A`tadna Lahum `Adhabaan 'Alimaan

v.t: The human being prays for evil as he prays for good. The human being is very hasty
v.l: Wa Yad`u Al-'Insanu Bish-Sharri Du`a'ahu Bil-Khayri Wa Kana Al-'Insanu `Ajulaan

v.t: We have made the night and the day two wonders. We erased the wonder of the night, and made the wonder of the day revealing, that you may seek bounty from your Lord, and know the number of years, and the calculation. We have explained all things in detail
v.l: Wa Ja`alna Al-Layla Wa An-Nahara 'Ayatayni Famahawna 'Ayata Al-Layli Wa Ja`alna 'Ayata An-Nahari Mubsiratan Litabtaghu Fađlaan Min Rabbikum Wa Lita`lamu `Adada As-Sinina Wa Al-Hisaba Wa Kulla Shay'in Fassalnahu Tafsilaan

v.t: For every person We have attached his fate to his neck. And on the Day of Resurrection, We will bring out for him a book which he will find spread open
v.l: Wa Kulla 'Insanin 'Alzamnahu Ta'irahu Fi `Unuqihi Wa Nukhriju Lahu Yawma Al-Qiyamati Kitabaan Yalqahu Manshuraan

v.t: “Read your book; today there will be none but yourself to call you to account.”
v.l: Iqra' Kitabaka Kafa Binafsika Al-Yawma `Alayka Hasibaan

v.t: Whoever is guided—is guided for his own good. And whoever goes astray—goes astray to his detriment. No burdened soul carries the burdens of another, nor do We ever punish until We have sent a messenger
v.l: Mani Ahtada Fa'innama Yahtadi Linafsihi Wa Man Đalla Fa'innama Yađillu `Alayha Wa La Taziru Waziratun Wizra 'Ukhra Wa Ma Kunna Mu`adhibina Hatta Nab`atha Rasulaan

v.t: When We decide to destroy a town, We command its affluent ones, they transgress in it, so the word becomes justified against it, and We destroy it completely
v.l: Wa 'Idha 'Aradna 'An Nuhlika Qaryatan 'Amarna Mutrafiha Fafasaqu Fiha Fahaqqa `Alayha Al-Qawlu Fadammarnaha Tadmiraan

v.t: How many generations have We destroyed after Noah? Your Lord is sufficient as Knower and Beholder of the sins of his servants
v.l: Wa Kam 'Ahlakna Mina Al-Quruni Min Ba`di Nuhin Wa Kafa Birabbika Bidhunubi `Ibadihi Khabiraan Basiraan

v.t: Whoever desires the fleeting life, We expedite for him what We decide to give him, to whomever We desire. Then We consign him to Hell, where he will roast, condemned and defeated
v.l: Man Kana Yuridu Al-`Ajilata `Ajjalna Lahu Fiha Ma Nasha'u Liman Nuridu Thumma Ja`alna Lahu Jahannama Yaslaha Madhmumaan Madhuraan

v.t: But whoever desires the Hereafter, and pursues it as it should be pursued, while he is a believer; these—their effort will be appreciated
v.l: Wa Man 'Arada Al-'Akhirata Wa Sa`a Laha Sa`yaha Wa Huwa Mu'uminun Fa'ula'ika Kana Sa`yuhum Mashkuraan

v.t: To all—these and those—We extend from the gifts of your Lord. The gifts of your Lord are not restricted
v.l: Kullaan Numiddu Ha'uula' Wa Ha'uula' Min `Ata'i Rabbika Wa Ma Kana `Ata'u Rabbika Mahzuraan

v.t: See how We have favored some of them over others; yet the Hereafter is greater in ranks, and greater in favors
v.l: Anzur Kayfa Fađđalna Ba`đahum `Ala Ba`đin Wa Lal'akhiratu 'Akbaru Darajatin Wa 'Akbaru Tafđilaan

v.t: Do not set up another god with God, lest you become condemned and damned
v.l: La Taj`al Ma`a Allahi 'Ilahaan 'Akhara Fataq`uda Madhmumaan Makhdhulaan

v.t: Your Lord has commanded that you worship none but Him, and that you be good to your parents. If either of them or both of them reach old age with you, do not say to them a word of disrespect, nor scold them, but say to them kind words
v.l: Wa Qađa Rabbuka 'Alla Ta`budu 'Illa 'Iyahu Wa Bil-Walidayni 'Ihsanaan 'Imma Yablughanna `Indaka Al-Kibara 'Ahaduhuma 'Aw Kilahuma Fala Taqul Lahuma 'Uffin Wa La Tanharhuma Wa Qul Lahuma Qawlaan Karimaan

v.t: And lower to them the wing of humility, out of mercy, and say, “My Lord, have mercy on them, as they raised me when I was a child.”
v.l: Wa Akhfiđ Lahuma Janaha Adh-Dhulli Mina Ar-Rahmati Wa Qul Rrabbi Arhamhuma Kama Rabbayani Saghiraan
w: Have mercy on both of them

v.t: Your Lord knows best what is in your minds. If you are righteous—He is Forgiving to the obedient
v.l: Rabbukum 'A`lamu Bima Fi Nufusikum 'In Takunu Salihina Fa'innahu Kana Lil'awwabina Ghafuraan
w: to those who often turn (to Him)

v.t: And give the relative his rights, and the poor, and the wayfarer, and do not squander wastefully
v.l: Wa 'Ati Dha Al-Qurba Haqqahu Wa Al-Miskina Wa Abna As-Sabili Wa La Tubadhir Tabdhiraan

v.t: The extravagant are brethren of the devils, and the devil is ever ungrateful to his Lord
v.l: Inna Al-Mubadhirina Kanu 'Ikhwana Ash-Shayatini Wa Kana Ash-Shaytanu Lirabbihi Kafuraan

v.t: But if you turn away from them, seeking mercy from your Lord which you hope for, then say to them words of comfort
v.l: Wa 'Imma Tu`riđanna `Anhumu Abtigha'a Rahmatin Min Rabbika Tarjuha Faqul Lahum Qawlaan Maysuraan

v.t: And do not keep your hand tied to your neck, nor spread it out fully, lest you end up liable and regretful
v.l: Wa La Taj`al Yadaka Maghlulatan 'Ila `Unuqika Wa La Tabsutha Kulla Al-Basti Fataq`uda Malumaan Mahsuraan

v.t: Your Lord expands the provision for whomever He wills, and restricts it. He is fully Informed, Observant of His servants
v.l: Inna Rabbaka Yabsutu Ar-Rizqa Liman Yasha'u Wa Yaqdiru 'Innahu Kana Bi`ibadihi Khabiraan Basiraan

v.t: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them, and for you. Killing them is a grave sin
v.l: Wa La Taqtulu 'Awladakum Khashyata 'Imlaqin Nahnu Narzuquhum Wa 'Iyakum 'Inna Qatlahum Kana Khit'aan Kabiraan

v.t: And do not come near adultery. It is immoral, and an evil way
v.l: Wa La Taqrabu Az-Zina 'Innahu Kana Fahishatan Wa Sa'a Sabilaan

v.t: And do not kill the soul which God has made sacred, except in the course of justice. If someone is killed unjustly, We have given his next of kin certain authority. But he should not be excessive in killing, for he will be supported
v.l: Wa La Taqtulu An-Nafsa Allati Harrama Allahu 'Illa Bil-Haqqi Wa Man Qutila Mazlumaan Faqad Ja`alna Liwaliyihi Sultanaan Fala Yusrif Fi Al-Qatli 'Innahu Kana Mansuraan

v.t: And do not go near the orphan’s property, except with the best of intentions, until he has reached his maturity. And honor your pledge, because the pledge involves responsibility
v.l: Wa La Taqrabu Mala Al-Yatimi 'Illa Bi-Ati Hiya 'Ahsanu Hatta Yablugha 'Ashuddahu Wa 'Awfu Bil-`Ahdi 'Inna Al-`Ahda Kana Mas'ulaan

v.t: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with accurate scales. That is fair, and the best determination
v.l: Wa 'Awfu Al-Kayla 'Idha Kiltum Wa Zinu Bil-Qistasi Al-Mustaqimi Dhalika Khayrun Wa 'Ahsanu Ta'wilaan

v.t: And do not occupy yourself with what you have no knowledge of. The hearing, and the sight, and the brains—all these will be questioned
v.l: Wa La Taqfu Ma Laysa Laka Bihi `Ilmun 'Inna As-Sam`a Wa Al-Basara Wa Al-Fu'uada Kullu 'Ula'ika Kana `Anhu Mas'ulaan

v.t: And do not walk proudly on earth. You can neither pierce the earth, nor can you match the mountains in height
v.l: Wa La Tamshi Fi Al-'Arđi Marahaan 'Innaka Lan Takhriqa Al-'Arđa Wa Lan Tablugha Al-Jibala Tulaan

v.t: The evil of all these is disliked by your Lord
v.l: Kullu Dhalika Kana Sayyi'uhu `Inda Rabbika Makruhaan

v.t: That is some of the wisdom your Lord has revealed to you. Do not set up with God another god, or else you will be thrown in Hell, rebuked and banished
v.l: Dhalika Mimma 'Awha 'Ilayka Rabbuka Mina Al-Hikmati Wa La Taj`al Ma`a Allahi 'Ilahaan 'Akhara Fatulqa Fi Jahannama Malumaan Madhuraan

v.t: Has your Lord favored you with sons, while choosing for Himself daughters from among the angels? You are indeed saying a terrible thing
v.l: Afa'asfakum Rabbukum Bil-Banina Wa Attakhadha Mina Al-Mala'ikati 'Inathaan 'Innakum Lataquluna Qawlaan `Azimaan
w: Then has your Lord chosen (for) you
Then has your Lord chosen (for) you

v.t: We have explained in this Quran in various ways, that they may remember, but it only adds to their rebellion
v.l: Wa Laqad Sarrafna Fi Hadha Al-Qur'ani Liyadhakkaru Wa Ma Yaziduhum 'Illa Nufuraan

v.t: Say, “If there were other gods with Him, as they say, they would have sought a way to the Lord of the Throne.”
v.l: Qul Law Kana Ma`ahu 'Alihatun Kama Yaquluna 'Idhaan Labtaghaw 'Ila Dhi Al-`Arshi Sabilaan

v.t: Be He glorified. He is exalted, far above what they say
v.l: Subhanahu Wa Ta`ala `Amma Yaquluna `Uluwaan Kabiraan

v.t: Praising Him are the seven heavens, and the earth, and everyone in them. There is not a thing that does not glorify Him with praise, but you do not understand their praises. He is indeed Forbearing and Forgiving
v.l: Tusabbihu Lahu As-Samawatu As-Sab`u Wa Al-'Arđu Wa Man Fihinna Wa 'In Min Shay'in 'Illa Yusabbihu Bihamdihi Wa Lakin La Tafqahuna Tasbihahum 'Innahu Kana Halimaan Ghafuraan

v.t: When you read the Quran, We place between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter an invisible barrier
v.l: Wa 'Idha Qara'ta Al-Qur'ana Ja`alna Baynaka Wa Bayna Al-Ladhina La Yu'uminuna Bil-'Akhirati Hijabaan Masturaan

v.t: And We drape veils over their hearts, preventing them from understanding it, and heaviness in their ears. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Quran, they turn their backs in aversion
v.l: Wa Ja`alna `Ala Qulubihim 'Akinnatan 'An Yafqahuhu Wa Fi 'Adhanihim Waqraan Wa 'Idha Dhakarta Rabbaka Fi Al-Qur'ani Wahdahu Wa Llaw `Ala 'Adbarihim Nufuraan

v.t: We know well what they listen to, when they listen to you, as they conspire, when the wrongdoers say, “You only follow a man bewitched.”
v.l: Nahnu 'A`lamu Bima Yastami`una Bihi 'Idh Yastami`una 'Ilayka Wa 'Idh Hum Najwa 'Idh Yaqulu Az-Zalimuna 'In Tattabi`una 'Illa Rajulaan Mashuraan

v.t: Note what they compared you to. They are lost, and unable to find a way
v.l: Anzur Kayfa Đarabu Laka Al-'Amthala Fađallu Fala Yastati`una Sabilaan

v.t: And they say, “When we have become bones and fragments, shall we really be resurrected as a new creation?”
v.l: Wa Qalu 'A'idha Kunna `Izamaan Wa Rufataan 'A'inna Lamab`uthuna Khalqaan Jadidaan

v.t: Say, “Even if you become rocks or iron
v.l: Qul Kunu Hijaratan 'Aw Hadidaan

v.t: Or some substance, which, in your minds, is even harder.” Then they will say, “Who will restore us?” Say, “The One who originated you the first time.” Then they will nod their heads at you, and say, “When will it be?” Say, “Perhaps it will be soon.”
v.l: Aw Khalqaan Mimma Yakburu Fi Sudurikum Fasayaquluna Man Yu`iduna Quli Al-Ladhi Fatarakum 'Awwala Marratin Fasayunghiđuna 'Ilayka Ru'usahum Wa Yaquluna Mata Huwa Qul `Asa 'An Yakuna Qaribaan

v.t: On the Day when He calls you, you will respond with His praise, and you will realize that you stayed only a little
v.l: Yawma Yad`ukum Fatastajibuna Bihamdihi Wa Tazunnuna 'In Labithtum 'Illa Qalilaan

v.t: Tell My servants to say what is best. Satan sows discord among them. Satan is to man an open enemy
v.l: Wa Qul Li`ibadi Yaqulu Allati Hiya 'Ahsanu 'Inna Ash-Shaytana Yanzaghu Baynahum 'Inna Ash-Shaytana Kana Lil'insani `Aduwaan Mubinaan

v.t: Your Lord knows you best. If He wills, He will have mercy on you; and if He wills, He will punish you. We did not send you as their advocate
v.l: Rabbukum 'A`lamu Bikum 'In Yasha' Yarhamkum 'Aw 'In Yasha' Yu`adhibkum Wa Ma 'Arsalnaka `Alayhim Wa Kilaan
w: He will have mercy on you

v.t: Your Lord knows well everyone in the heavens and the earth. We have given some prophets advantage over others; and to David We gave the Psalms
v.l: Wa Rabbuka 'A`lamu Biman Fi As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Wa Laqad Fađđalna Ba`đa An-Nabiyina `Ala Ba`đin Wa 'Atayna Dawuda Zaburaan

v.t: Say, “Call upon those you claim besides Him. They have no power to relieve your adversity, nor can they change it.”
v.l: Quli Ad`u Al-Ladhina Za`amtum Min Dunihi Fala Yamlikuna Kashfa Ađ-Đurri `Ankum Wa La Tahwilaan

v.t: Those they call upon are themselves seeking means of access to their Lord, vying to be nearer, and hoping for His mercy, and fearing His punishment. The punishment of your Lord is to be dreaded
v.l: Ula'ika Al-Ladhina Yad`una Yabtaghuna 'Ila Rabbihimu Al-Wasilata 'Ayyuhum 'Aqrabu Wa Yarjuna Rahmatahu Wa Yakhafuna `Adhabahu 'Inna `Adhaba Rabbika Kana Mahdhuraan

v.t: There is no city but We will destroy before the Day of Resurrection, or punish it with a severe punishment. This is inscribed in the Book
v.l: Wa 'In Min Qaryatin 'Illa Nahnu Muhlikuha Qabla Yawmi Al-Qiyamati 'Aw Mu`adhibuha `Adhabaan Shadidaan Kana Dhalika Fi Al-Kitabi Masturaan

v.t: Nothing prevents Us from sending miraculous signs, except that the ancients called them lies. We gave Thamood the she-camel, a visible sign, but they mistreated her. We do not send the signs except to instill reverence
v.l: Wa Ma Mana`ana 'An Nursila Bil-'Ayati 'Illa 'An Kadhaba Biha Al-'Awwaluna Wa 'Atayna Thamuda An-Naqata Mubsiratan Fazalamu Biha Wa Ma Nursilu Bil-'Ayati 'Illa Takhwifaan

v.t: We said to you that your Lord encompasses humanity. We did not make the vision We showed you, except as a test for the people, and the tree cursed in the Quran. We frighten them, but that only increases their defiance
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qulna Laka 'Inna Rabbaka 'Ahata Bin-Nasi Wa Ma Ja`alna Ar-Ru'uya Allati 'Araynaka 'Illa Fitnatan Lilnnasi Wa Ash-Shajarata Al-Mal`unata Fi Al-Qur'ani Wa Nukhawwifuhum Fama Yaziduhum 'Illa Tughyanaan Kabiraan

v.t: When We said to the angels, “Bow down before Adam,” they bowed down, except for Satan. He said, “Shall I bow down before someone You created from mud?”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qulna Lilmala'ikati Asjudu Li'dama Fasajadu 'Illa 'Iblisa Qala 'A'asjudu Liman Khalaqta Tinaan

v.t: He said, “Do You see this one whom You have honored more than me? If You reprieve me until the Day of Resurrection, I will bring his descendants under my sway, except for a few.”
v.l: Qala 'Ara'aytaka Hadha Al-Ladhi Karramta `Alayya La'in 'Akhkhartani 'Ila Yawmi Al-Qiyamati La'ahtanikanna Dhurriyatahu 'Illa Qalilaan

v.t: He said, “Begone! Whoever of them follows you—Hell is your reward, an ample reward.”
v.l: Qala Adh/hab Faman Tabi`aka Minhum Fa'inna Jahannama Jaza'uukum Jaza'an Mawfuraan

v.t: “And entice whomever of them you can with your voice, and rally against them your cavalry and your infantry, and share with them in wealth and children, and make promises to them.” But Satan promises them nothing but delusion
v.l: Wa Astafziz Mani Astata`ta Minhum Bisawtika Wa 'Ajlib `Alayhim Bikhaylika Wa Rajilika Wa Sharik/hum Fi Al-'Amwli Wa Al-'Awladi Wa `Id/hum Wa Ma Ya`iduhumu Ash-Shaytanu 'Illa Ghururaan

v.t: “As for My devotees, you have no authority over them.” Your Lord is an adequate Guardian
v.l: Inna `Ibadi Laysa Laka `Alayhim Sultanun Wa Kafa Birabbika Wa Kilaan

v.t: Your Lord is He who propels for you the ships at sea, that you may seek of His bounty. He is towards you Most Merciful
v.l: Rabbukumu Al-Ladhi Yuzji Lakumu Al-Fulka Fi Al-Bahri Litabtaghu Min Fađlihi 'Innahu Kana Bikum Rahimaan

v.t: When harm afflicts you at sea, those you pray to vanish, except for Him. But when He saves you to land, you turn away. The human being is ever thankless
v.l: Wa 'Idha Massakumu Ađ-Đurru Fi Al-Bahri Đalla Man Tad`una 'Illa 'Iyahu Falamma Najjakum 'Ila Al-Barri 'A`rađtum Wa Kana Al-'Insanu Kafuraan

v.t: Are you confident that He will not cause a track of land to cave in beneath you, or unleash a tornado against you, and then you find no protector
v.l: Afa'amintum 'An Yakhsifa Bikum Janiba Al-Barri 'Aw Yursila `Alaykum Hasibaan Thumma La Tajidu Lakum Wa Kilaan

v.t: Or are you confident that He will not return you to it once again, and unleash a hurricane against you, and drown you for your ingratitude? Then you will find no helper against Us
v.l: Am 'Amintum 'An Yu`idakum Fihi Taratan 'Ukhra Fayursila `Alaykum Qasifaan Mina Ar-Rihi Fayughriqakum Bima Kafartum Thumma La Tajidu Lakum `Alayna Bihi Tabi`aan

v.t: We have honored the Children of Adam, and carried them on land and sea, and provided them with good things, and greatly favored them over many of those We created
v.l: Wa Laqad Karramna Bani 'Adama Wa Hamalnahum Fi Al-Barri Wa Al-Bahri Wa Razaqnahum Mina At-Tayyibati Wa Fađđalnahum `Ala Kathirin Mimman Khalaqna Tafđilaan

v.t: On the Day when We call every people with their leader. Whoever is given his record in his right hand—these will read their record, and they will not be wronged one bit
v.l: Yawma Nad`u Kulla 'Unasin Bi'imamihim Faman 'Utiya Kitabahu Biyaminihi Fa'ula'ika Yaqra'una Kitabahum Wa La Yuzlamuna Fatilaan
w: (even as much as) a hair on a date seed

v.t: But whoever is blind in this, he will be blind in the Hereafter, and further astray from the way
v.l: Wa Man Kana Fi Hadhihi 'A`ma Fahuwa Fi Al-'Akhirati 'A`ma Wa 'Ađallu Sabilaan

v.t: They almost lured you away from what We have revealed to you, so that you would invent something else in Our name. In that case, they would have taken you for a friend
v.l: Wa 'In Kadu Layaftinunaka `Ani Al-Ladhi 'Awhayna 'Ilayka Litaftariya `Alayna Ghayrahu Wa 'Idhaan Lattakhadhuka Khalilaan

v.t: Had We not given you stability, you might have inclined towards them a little
v.l: Wa Lawla 'An Thabbatnaka Laqad Kidtta Tarkanu 'Ilayhim Shay'aan Qalilaan

v.t: Then We would have made you taste double in life, and double at death; then you would have found for yourself no helper against Us
v.l: Idhaan La'adhaqnaka Đi`fa Al-Hayaati Wa Đi`fa Al-Mamati Thumma La Tajidu Laka `Alayna Nasiraan

v.t: They almost provoked you, to expel you from the land. In that case, they would not have lasted after you, except briefly
v.l: Wa 'In Kadu Layastafizzunaka Mina Al-'Arđi Liyukhrijuka Minha Wa 'Idhaan La Yalbathuna Khilafaka 'Illa Qalilaan

v.t: The tradition of the messengers We sent before you—you will find no change in Our rules
v.l: Sunnata Man Qad 'Arsalna Qablaka Min Rusulina Wa La Tajidu Lisunnatina Tahwilaan

v.t: Perform the prayer at the decline of the sun, until the darkness of the night; and the Quran at dawn. The Quran at dawn is witnessed
v.l: Aqimi As-Salaata Liduluki Ash-Shamsi 'Ila Ghasaqi Al-Layli Wa Qur'ana Al-Fajri 'Inna Qur'ana Al-Fajri Kana Mash/hudaan

v.t: And keep vigil with it during parts of the night, as an extra prayer. Perhaps your Lord will raise you to a laudable position
v.l: Wa Mina Al-Layli Fatahajjad Bihi Nafilatan Laka `Asa 'An Yab`athaka Rabbuka Maqamaan Mahmudaan

v.t: And say, “My Lord, lead me in through an entry of truth, and lead me out through an exit of truth, and grant me from You a supporting power.”
v.l: Wa Qul Rabbi 'Adkhilni Mudkhala Sidqin Wa 'Akhrijni Mukhraja Sidqin Wa Aj`al Li Min Ladunka Sultanaan Nasiraan

v.t: And say, “The truth has come, and falsehood has withered away; for falsehood is bound to wither away.”
v.l: Wa Qul Ja'a Al-Haqqu Wa Zahaqa Al-Batilu 'Inna Al-Batila Kana Zahuqaan

v.t: We send down in the Quran healing and mercy for the believers, but it increases the wrongdoers only in loss
v.l: Wa Nunazzilu Mina Al-Qur'ani Ma Huwa Shifa'un Wa Rahmatun Lilmu'uminina Wa La Yazidu Az-Zalimina 'Illa Khasaraan

v.t: When We bless the human being, he turns away and distances himself. But when adversity touches him, he is in despair
v.l: Wa 'Idha 'An`amna `Ala Al-'Insani 'A`rađa Wa Na'a Bijanibihi Wa 'Idha Massahu Ash-Sharru Kana Ya'usaan

v.t: Say, “Each does according to his disposition. Your Lord knows best who is better guided in the way.”
v.l: Qul Kullun Ya`malu `Ala Shakilatihi Farabbukum 'A`lamu Biman Huwa 'Ahda Sabilaan

v.t: And they ask you about the Spirit. Say, “The Spirit belongs to the domain of my Lord; and you were given only little knowledge.”
v.l: Wa Yas'alunaka `Ani Ar-Ruhi Quli Ar-Ruhu Min 'Amri Rabbi Wa Ma 'Utitum Mina Al-`Ilmi 'Illa Qalilaan

v.t: If We willed, We could take away what We revealed to you. Then you will find for yourself no protecting guardian against Us
v.l: Wa La'in Shi'na Lanadh/habanna Bial-Ladhi 'Awhayna 'Ilayka Thumma La Tajidu Laka Bihi `Alayna Wa Kilaan

v.t: Except through a mercy from your Lord. His favors upon you have been great
v.l: Illa Rahmatan Min Rabbika 'Inna Fađlahu Kana `Alayka Kabiraan

v.t: Say, “If mankind and jinn came together to produce the like of this Quran, they could never produce the like of it, even if they backed up one another.”
v.l: Qul La'ini Ajtama`ati Al-'Insu Wa Al-Jinnu `Ala 'An Ya'tu Bimithli Hadha Al-Qur'ani La Ya'tuna Bimithlihi Wa Law Kana Ba`đuhum Liba`đin Zahiraan

v.t: We have displayed for mankind in this Quran every kind of similitude, but most people insist on denying the truth
v.l: Wa Laqad Sarrafna Lilnnasi Fi Hadha Al-Qur'ani Min Kulli Mathalin Fa'aba 'Aktharu An-Nasi 'Illa Kufuraan

v.t: And they said, “We will not believe in you unless you make a spring burst from the ground for us
v.l: Wa Qalu Lan Nu'umina Laka Hatta Tafjura Lana Mina Al-'Arđi Yanbu`aan

v.t: Or you have a garden of palms and vines; then cause rivers to gush pouring through them
v.l: Aw Takuna Laka Jannatun Min Nakhilin Wa `Inabin Fatufajjira Al-'Anhara Khilalaha Tafjiraan

v.t: Or make the sky fall on us in pieces, as you claim, or bring God and the angels before us
v.l: Aw Tusqita As-Sama'a Kama Za`amta `Alayna Kisafaan 'Aw Ta'tiya Billahi Wa Al-Mala'ikati Qabilaan

v.t: Or you possess a house of gold. Or you ascend into the sky. Even then, we will not believe in your ascension, unless you bring down for us a book that we can read.” Say, “Glory be to my Lord. Am I anything but a human messenger?”
v.l: Aw Yakuna Laka Baytun Min Zukhrufin 'Aw Tarqa Fi As-Sama'i Wa Lan Nu'umina Liruqiyika Hatta Tunazzila `Alayna Kitabaan Naqra'uuhu Qul Subhana Rabbi Hal Kuntu 'Illa Basharaan Rasulaan

v.t: Nothing prevented the people from believing, when guidance has come to them, except that they said, “Did God send a human messenger?”
v.l: Wa Ma Mana`a An-Nasa 'An Yu'uminu 'Idh Ja'ahumu Al-Huda 'Illa 'An Qalu 'Aba`atha Allahu Basharaan Rasulaan

v.t: Say, “If there were angels on earth, walking around in peace, We would have sent down to them from heaven an angel messenger.”
v.l: Qul Law Kana Fi Al-'Arđi Mala'ikatun Yamshuna Mutma'innina Lanazzalna `Alayhim Mina As-Sama'i Malakaan Rasulaan

v.t: Say, “God is enough witness between you and me. He is fully aware of His servants, and He sees them well.”
v.l: Qul Kafa Billahi Shahidaan Bayni Wa Baynakum 'Innahu Kana Bi`ibadihi Khabiraan Basiraan

v.t: Whomever God guides is the guided one. And whomever He leaves astray—for them you will find no protectors apart from Him. And We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection, on their faces, blind, dumb, and deaf. Their abode is Hell; whenever it abates, We intensify the blaze for them
v.l: Wa Man Yahdi Allahu Fahuwa Al-Muhtadi Wa Man Yuđlil Falan Tajida Lahum 'Awliya'a Min Dunihi Wa Nahshuruhum Yawma Al-Qiyamati `Ala Wajuhihim `Umyaan Wa Bukmaan Wa Summaan Ma'wahum Jahannamu Kullama Khabat Zidnahum Sa`iraan

v.t: This is their repayment for having blasphemed against Our revelations, and having said, “Shall we, when we have become bones and fragments, be resurrected as a new creation?”
v.l: Dhalika Jaza'uuhum Bi'annahum Kafaru Bi'ayatina Wa Qalu 'A'idha Kunna `Izamaan Wa Rufataan 'A'inna Lamab`uthuna Khalqaan Jadidaan

v.t: Do they not consider that God, Who created the heavens and the earth, is Able to create the likes of them? He has assigned for them a term, in which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers persist in denying the truth
v.l: Awalam Yaraw 'Anna Allaha Al-Ladhi Khalaqa As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Qadirun `Ala 'An Yakhluqa Mithlahum Wa Ja`ala Lahum 'Ajalaan La Rayba Fihi Fa'aba Az-Zalimuna 'Illa Kufuraan

v.t: Say, “If you possessed the treasuries of my Lord’s mercy, you would have withheld them for fear of spending.” The human being has always been stingy
v.l: Qul Law 'Antum Tamlikuna Khaza'ina Rahmati Rabbi 'Idhaan La'amsaktum Khashyata Al-'Infaqi Wa Kana Al-'Insanu Qaturaan

v.t: We gave Moses nine clear signs—ask the Children of Israel. When he went to them, Pharaoh said to him, “I think that you, Moses, are bewitched.”
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Musa Tis`a 'Ayatin Bayyinatin Fas'l Bani 'Isra'ila 'Idh Ja'ahum Faqala Lahu Fir`awnu 'Inni La'azunnuka Yamusa Mashuraan

v.t: He said, “You know that none sent these down except the Lord of the heavens and the earth—eye openers; and I think that you, Pharaoh, are doomed.”
v.l: Qala Laqad `Alimta Ma 'Anzala Ha'uula' 'Illa Rabbu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi Basa'ira Wa 'Inni La'azunnuka Ya Fir`awnu Mathburaan

v.t: He resolved to scare them off the land, but We drowned him, and those with him, altogether
v.l: Fa'arada 'An Yastafizzahum Mina Al-'Arđi Fa'aghraqnahu Wa Man Ma`ahu Jami`aan

v.t: After him, We said to the Children of Israel, “Inhabit the land, and when the promise of the Hereafter arrives, We will bring you all together.”
v.l: Wa Qulna Min Ba`dihi Libani 'Isra'ila Askunu Al-'Arđa Fa'idha Ja'a Wa`du Al-'Akhirati Ji'na Bikum Lafifaan

v.t: With the truth We sent it down, and with the truth it descended. We sent you only as a bearer of good news and a warner
v.l: Wa Bil-Haqqi 'Anzalnahu Wa Bil-Haqqi Nazala Wa Ma 'Arsalnaka 'Illa Mubashiraan Wa Nadhiraan

v.t: A Quran which We unfolded gradually, that you may recite to the people over time. And We revealed it in stages
v.l: Wa Qur'anaan Faraqnahu Litaqra'ahu `Ala An-Nasi `Ala Mukthin Wa Nazzalnahu Tanzilaan

v.t: Say, “Believe in it, or do not believe.” Those who were given knowledge before it, when it is recited to them, they fall to their chins, prostrating
v.l: Qul 'Aminu Bihi 'Aw La Tu'uminu 'Inna Al-Ladhina 'Utu Al-`Ilma Min Qablihi 'Idha Yutla `Alayhim Yakhirruna Lil'adhqani Sujjadaan

v.t: And they say, “Glory to our Lord. The promise of our Lord is fulfilled.”
v.l: Wa Yaquluna Subhana Rabbina 'In Kana Wa`du Rabbina Lamaf`ulaan

v.t: And they fall to their chins, weeping, and it adds to their humility
v.l: Wa Yakhirruna Lil'adhqani Yabkuna Wa Yaziduhum Khushu`aan

v.t: Say, “Call Him God, or call Him the Most Merciful. Whichever name you use, to Him belong the Best Names.” And be neither loud in your prayer, nor silent in it, but follow a course in between
v.l: Qul Ad`u Allaha 'Aw Ad`u Ar-Rahmana 'Ayyaanan Mma Tad`u Falahu Al-'Asma'u Al-Husna Wa La Tajhar Bisalatika Wa La Tukhafit Biha Wa Abtaghi Bayna Dhalika Sabilaan

v.t: And say, “Praise be to God, who has not begotten a son, nor has He a partner in sovereignty, nor has He an ally out of weakness, and glorify Him constantly.”
v.l: Wa Quli Al-Hamdu Lillahi Al-Ladhi Lam Yattakhidh Waladaan Wa Lam Yakun Lahu Sharikun Fi Al-Mulki Wa Lam Yakun Lahu Wa Liyun Mina Adh-Dhulli Wa Kabbirhu Takbiraan
